subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake is a network of underground rivers, natural tunnels, and canals that connect innumerable water-filled caverns and chambers.
source_quote: The Darklake is a network of underground rivers, natural tunnels, and canals that connect innumerable water-filled caverns and chambers.

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake stretches over a hundred miles across, with ceilings that are miles high in some places and depths that are unfathomable.
source_quote: This vast waterway stretches over a hundred miles across, with ceilings that are miles high in some places and depths that are unfathomable.

subject: duergar
fact: Duergar engineers extended and widened many of the interconnecting passages of the Darklake.
source_quote: Long ago, duergar engineers extended and widened many of the interconnecting passages of the Darklake.

subject: duergar
fact: Duergar constructed locks for raising and lowering watercraft to different levels within the Darklake.
source_quote: They also constructed locks for raising and lowering watercraft to different levels within it, opening up large portions of the network for travel.

subject: kuo-toa
fact: Kuo-toa are experienced in navigating the Darklake.
source_quote: Many Underdark creatures are experienced in navigating the Darklake, including the kuo-toa.

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh can be reached via the Darklake.
source_quote: We can get to Gracklstugh, Blingdenstone, or wherever we want from the Darklake.

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone can be reached via the Darklake.
source_quote: We can get to Gracklstugh, Blingdenstone, or wherever we want from the Darklake.

subject: Sloopdopblop
fact: Sloopdopblop is eight days away from the current location via the Darklake.
source_quote: if what Shuushar says is true, the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: session date
fact: The session date is the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: ## 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: group begins march
fact: The group begins the long march through the darkness after the long rest.
source_quote: The group begins the long march through the darkness after the long rest.

subject: tunnels
fact: The tunnels alternate between pitch-pure darkness or lit with the surreal magic of the Faerzress.
source_quote: The tunnels alternate between pitch-pure darkness or lit with the surreal magic of the *Faerzress (*Fay-YERR-zess).

subject: Stool
fact: Stool was a fellow prisoner in Velkynvelve.
source_quote: Stool, whom they had met as a fellow prisoner in Velkynvelve

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is curled against Grygum when he wakes up.
source_quote: Stool, whom they had met as a fellow prisoner in Velkynvelve, was curled against him.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool cries when Grygum tries to push him away.
source_quote: when the orc tried to push him away, the myconid cried.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool says he is lonely, scared, and terrified.
source_quote: Stool explained that he was lonely, scared, and terrified.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool believes Grygum will bring him home.
source_quote: he knew Grygum would bring him home.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool wants to be Grygum’s best friend.
source_quote: He knew he wanted to be Grygum’s best friend.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum tells Stool they can be friends.
source_quote: He sighed and told the creature that they could be friends.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum takes Stool’s hand.
source_quote: When stool extended his hand, Grygum took it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recognizes Stool is seeking an adult figure to protect him.
source_quote: he could tell when a child was looking for an adult figure to protect it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum acknowledges that having a myconid allows the group to surprise enemies using Stool’s telepathic powers.
source_quote: But it wasn’t only altruism. Having a myconid would allow the group to surprise enemies using the telepathic powers Stool imbued his allies with.

subject: group finds fungus
fact: Jimjar points out a fungus that Thorin thinks looks like a giant’s tongue.
source_quote: Well, look at this,” shouts Jimjar. The group stops and stares at the fungus he is pointing at. Thorin thinks it looks like a giant’s tongue.

subject: fungus
fact: Sarith says the fungus is the tastiest thing in the world.
source_quote: Tastiest thing in the world,” says Sarith.

subject: fungus
fact: Shuushar says the fungus is called the Tongue of Madness and connects its eater to the gods.
source_quote: It is said that when you eat this mushroom, you connect with the gods.

subject: Thorin eats fungus
fact: Thorin eats the fungus and gets a vague impression of a psychedelic effect but feels no different afterward.
source_quote: Thorin is dubious but chooses to eat the mushroom. He gets the vague impression that it has a psychedelic effect, but he doesn’t feel any different afterward.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'You know, that Myconid thing probably tastes delicious. And Shuushar, you really have big eyes.'
source_quote: You know, that Myconid thing probably tastes delicious. And Shuushar, you really have big eyes.

subject: prisoners laugh at Thorin
fact: The prisoners from the Underdark start to laugh after Thorin speaks.
source_quote: everyone stares at him, and then the prisoners from the Underdark start to laugh.

subject: Buppido asks Thorin about giants
fact: Buppido asks Thorin if it is true what they say about giants.
source_quote: Buppido asks Thorin, “So tell us the truth. Is it true what they say about Giants?”

subject: Thorin tells truth about giants
fact: Thorin attempts to lie but tells the truth.
source_quote: And Thorin attempts to lie but tells the truth.

subject: everyone laughs harder
fact: Everyone laughs harder after Thorin tells the truth about giants.
source_quote: And then everyone laughs even harder.

subject: Tongue of Madness revealed
fact: Shuushar explains that the Tongue of Madness compels its eater to say the truth.
source_quote: The Tongue of Madness will compel its eater to say the truth.

subject: group eats fungus
fact: The rest of the group eats the mushroom and sits silently, unwilling to reveal anything.
source_quote: the rest eat the mushroom and sit silently. They are all unwilling to reveal anything.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir declares a vow of silence after eating the fungus.
source_quote: Zalthir stares at the group, ats the mushroom, and declares a vow of silence.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido looks at Zalthir funny after he declares his vow of silence.
source_quote: Buppido looks at him, funny.

subject: group continues journey
fact: The group continues their journey into the dark after eating the fungus.
source_quote: Once they have eaten, the group continues their journey into the dark.

subject: large cavern
fact: The group arrives at a large cavern.
source_quote: They arrive at a large cavern

subject: tremor and rockfall
fact: A tremor is felt in the large cavern, and then rocks fall before anyone can react.
source_quote: as they stretch their arms, a tremor can be felt. And then, before anyone can react, rocks fall.

subject: group trapped under rocks
fact: Topsy, Buppido, Jimjar, Eldeth, Grygum, and Shuushar are trapped under the rocks after the rockfall.
source_quote: Topsy, Buppido, Jimjar, Eldeth, Grygum, and Shuushar are trapped under the rocks.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum shouts that he is fine after being trapped under rocks.
source_quote: Grygum shouts that he’s fine

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is silent after the rockfall.
source_quote: Daz is silent.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir examines Daz and concludes he is unconscious.
source_quote: Zalthir examines the mage and concludes that he’s unconscious.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz will die if he is not rescued from under the rocks in time.
source_quote: And will die if he doesn’t get him out in time.
